entities.summary: Ade Bethune was an American liturgical artist. She was associated with the Catholic Worker Movement, and designed an early masthead of its publication, the Catholic Worker, first used in 1935. She later re-designed this in 1985, replacing one of the men with a woman. Ade Bethune was a painters & sculptors from Schaerbeek (1914-01-12, Schaerbeek–2002-05-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
